subcategory: animated tab navigation with sliding cursor
use_cases: Main site navigation with smooth cursor transitions between menu items
Product page tab switching for features, specs, and reviews
Dashboard navigation between different views or settings
Filter tabs in product catalogs or content feeds
Step-by-step wizard navigation with visual progress indicator
ai_summary: An animated tab navigation component featuring a sliding pill-shaped cursor that smoothly transitions between tabs on hover using Framer Motion. The cursor uses CSS mix-blend-mode for contrast, and the tabs have responsive sizing for mobile and desktop. The animation triggers on mouse enter with opacity fade on mouse leave, creating a polished, interactive navigation experience suitable for modern web applications.
